title: Experiment run
description: One recorded run under experiments/<project-slug>/<run-id>/, separate from a single delivery's docs/<date>/<slug>/<version>/ tree and from .agent-state/ (ephemeral, ungeneralizable across runs). config.json and metrics.json each validate against the matching $defs entry here.

config.description: config.json: the inputs this run varied, so a later run-id can be diffed against it field by field.

model.description: Model name and version, e.g. "claude-sonnet-5" or a local checkpoint id.

dataset.description: Dataset name and version, when the run reads one.

hyperparameters.description: Free-form; whatever this run's method varies (learning rate, temperature, top_k, ...).

seed.description: Random seed, for reproducing this exact run.

metrics.description: metrics.json: the same {metrics, thresholds, integrity} shape experiment/METRICS.json uses, so one parser reads both. integrity is required: a metric with no record of which data it was chosen on cannot be told apart from a tuned one.

thresholds.description: Metric name to the comparison this run must meet, if any.

op.description: Matches exactly what runtime/internal/verifier/results.go's compareMetric implements. != is deliberately absent: the real comparator has no case for it and silently returns false, so a schema advertising it here would validate a threshold every future comparator would misread the same way.

integrity.description: The evaluation record beside the metrics. Self-reported, so it does not stop deliberate fraud; it forces the facts that expose silent leakage and test-set tuning into a file the results verifier reads. Mirrors runtime/internal/verifier/integrity.go. Declare the values in the approved PLAN before the run.

kind.description: held_out_eval: the headline metrics come from data no choice was tuned on. not_applicable: there is no model, split, or tuning step; say why in reason.

selectionSplit.description: Where hyperparameters, prompts, features, checkpoints, and thresholds were chosen.

reportedSplit.description: The held-out split the headline metrics come from. Must differ from selectionSplit.

selectionMetrics.description: The gated metrics measured on selectionSplit.

maxGap.description: Largest accepted absolute difference between selectionMetrics and metrics, per gated metric.

trials.description: Every configuration tried to reach this run, failures included.

reportedSplitEvaluations.description: Times reportedSplit was scored over the whole project. Must be 1: a split scored twice is no longer held out.
